Description
The University of Strathclyde is located in Glasgow, Scotland and was founded in 1796 making it Glasgow's second-oldest university.
The institution was named University of the Year 2012 by Times Higher Education and again in 2019, becoming the first university to receive this award twice. Strathclyde was one of the 5 hardest UK universities to get into in 2020.
The Undergraduate Foundation Program is a preparation program for international students who don’t meet the direct entry requirements for an undergraduate degree at the University of Strathclyde. Once you successfully complete the program, students will progress to the second year of a four-year undergraduate degree (some exceptions apply).
